messages:
Maya Rao: heads up — after last night's terraform roll (module v3.2) i'm seeing GPU nodepools in prod-west1 stuck at Pending for scale-up, app pods still pending :/
Ravi Patel: saw alerts. cluster-autoscaler logs show a lot of "no candidates found" and then repeated create/terminate churn. any recent changes to taints/labels?
Jules K.: yep, tf module v3.2 accidentally started applying taint `gpu: dedicated:NoSchedule` to new nodegroups. i noticed it in the plan but it slipped through during apply.
Maya Rao: ahhh that would explain pods not binding. but CA should still add nodes if pods need GPUs, no? what's the exact CA error?
Ravi Patel: tail from autoscaler pod: `I0324 03:12:11.123456 1 scale_up.go:312] No candidates: node group gpu-west1-spot is at max size` then `I0324 03:12:20.987654 1 scale_up.go:330] Rejected because 0 of 3 subnets have free IPs`
Jules K.: so two problems: taint prevented existing nodes from ever matching workloads, and subnet IP exhaustion prevented new instances from attaching IPs. Ops hit both at once.
Maya Rao: great. what's the fastest short-term mitigation?
Ravi Patel: immediate steps i propose: 1) bump ASG max size + subnet secondary ip quota, 2) rollback the taint change in terraform (remove taint) so existing pools accept workloads, 3) in parallel patch the gpu workloads to include tolerations so long-term they can co-exist with taints.
Jules K.: agreed. i can patch the helm values for the gpu workload chart with tolerations snippet. quick patch: ```yaml
tolerations:
  - key: "gpu"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "dedicated"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
```
Kai (infra-bot): quota request submitted to cloud console: request id q-02b4 — increasing secondary IPs for subnet subnet-prod-west1-a from 256 -> 1024. estimated approval 10-15m.
Maya Rao: perfect. i'll also open a rollback PR for the nodepool taint and tag it hotfix. who wants to own the terraform apply?
Jules K.: i'll own the tf rollback and plan+apply; will run it with `-target=module.node_pool.gpu` first to limit blast radius.
Ravi Patel: i'll patch the helm release for the gpu pod tolerations and also temporarily increase ASG mixedInstancesPolicy max size for the spot group to +20.
Maya Rao: do we need a CA config tweak? i remember v3.2 changed chart defaults (expander: least-waste) which might be steering scale decisions badly.
Jules K.: good catch — the chart change also flipped `expander` and added `--skip-nodes-with-system-pods=true` by default. i'll roll the CA helm values back to our previous: `expander: priority` and `skip-nodes-with-system-pods: false`. snippet for helm patch: ```yaml
clusterAutoscaler:
  extraArgs:
    expander: "priority"
    skip-nodes-with-system-pods: "false"
```
Ravi Patel: once taint rollback + tolerations applied + quota increased, we should see pending pods schedule within a couple minutes. i'll monitor K8s events and CA logs.
ops-bot: Incident incident-2026-03-24-gpu-scaleup created — severity: high. responders: @Maya Rao @Ravi Patel @Jules K.
Maya Rao: rolling plan: (1) patch helm tolerations (Jules) — done in staging and then prod; (2) submit tf taint rollback PR (Maya) and then apply (Jules); (3) quota bump (Kai) in progress; (4) CA helm rollback (Jules) and restart CA pods; (5) monitor, then scale down if healthy.
Jules K.: applying CA helm rollback now in prod-west1 namespace `infra` with `helm upgrade --install cluster-autoscaler chart/ca -f values-prod.yaml` (using canary release tag). i'll keep logs here.
Ravi Patel: i'm seeing nodes coming up in ASG but a couple of them are still `NotReady` due to kubelet complaining about `failed to allocate device plugin resources` — likely GPU driver bootstrap timing. adding `node.kubernetes.io/not-ready:NoSchedule` toleration on our scheduled pods might help temporarily.
Maya Rao: let's not change app manifests to tolerate not-ready nodes. better to let kubelet finish. how long until taint rollback PR is ready?
Jules K.: PR open: https://git.internal/rf/infra/terraform/compare/rollback-nodepool-taint — small change, plan shows removal of `taints = [{key = "gpu", value = "dedicated", effect = "NO_SCHEDULE"}]`. i'll apply once quota confirmed.
Kai (infra-bot): quota increase approved; cloud console shows available IPs updated.
Ravi Patel: okay i'm seeing pending pods start to bind to new nodes. autoscaler logs show successful scale-up for nodegroup gpu-west1-spot.
Maya Rao: awesome. after things calm down we should: (A) add CI check that tf plans with taint changes must have associated workload tolerations, (B) add a preflight check for subnet secondary ip utilization during nodepool rollout, (C) revert CA chart defaults change in our helm chart repo so future upgrades don't flip things.
Jules K.: agreed. i'll file follow-ups in infra backlog. quick TODOs recorded: infra#342 add tf plan guard, infra#343 subnet preflight check, infra#344 pin CA chart defaults.
Ravi Patel: thumbs up. closing incident when all pods stable for 15m. i'll keep watching for spot interruption churn — might also switch allocationStrategy to `capacity-optimized` in ASG launch template to reduce termination risk.
Maya Rao: thanks all — great quick collaboration. I'll post a short blurb in #postmortems once we finalize RCA and follow-ups. :thumbsup:
